Event
Israel launches 'Operation Rising Lion', conducting surprise airstrikes on Iranian nuclear facilities (Fordow, Natanz, Isfahan) and assassinating top military commanders.
Iran responds with 'Operation True Promise III', launching massive salvos of ballistic missiles and drones at Israeli military and infrastructure targets.
Israeli strikes severely damage Iranian energy infrastructure, including the Shahr Rey refinery and South Pars gas field, sharply reducing Iran's oil exports.
The U.S. directly intervenes with 'Operation Midnight Hammer', deploying B-2 stealth bombers to strike deeply buried Iranian nuclear enrichment plants.
Iran retaliates against U.S. involvement by striking the Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar, signaling a potential broader regional escalation.
A U.S.-brokered ceasefire formally comes into effect, bringing an end to the 12-Day War.
Israel orders new evacuations in Khan Younis and Rafah.
Military operations in Tulkarm/Nur Shams displace 40,000; Hamas agrees to 10-hostage release for withdrawal.
Ongoing negotiations over U.S.-brokered 60-day ceasefire; dispute over Morag Corridor remains.
Israeli cabinet decides to conquer Gaza City, overriding resistance from army leadership.
IDF mobilizes 60,000 reserve troops to take over Gaza City and orders the evacuation of Jabalia.
Netanyahu delivers 'Sparta Speech' at the International Convention Center in Jerusalem.
Prime Minister Netanyahu addresses the UN General Assembly; Israel controversially broadcasts the speech into Gaza using military loudspeakers.
U.S. President Donald Trump and PM Netanyahu reveal a 20-point peace plan for Gaza, introducing the transitional 'Board of Peace'.
A new ceasefire formally comes into effect after Israel and Hamas agree to the first phase of the U.S.-brokered peace plan.
All remaining living Israeli hostages are released by Hamas, and Israel frees nearly 2,000 Palestinian prisoners. A major peace summit is held in Egypt.

42-year-old Majed Mohammad Dawoud killed during Israeli raid in Nablus.
The UN Security Council formally endorses the October peace plan and the creation of the transitional Board of Peace.
